fields.label: a
fields.hint: Compare the higher-priority substituent on each carbon of the double bond.
fields.explanation: Ethyl outranks methyl on the left, and Cl outranks carbon on the right. Both higher-priority groups are below the double bond: Z.
fields.selectionPrompt: Choose the correct response for a.

fields.label: b
fields.hint: Compare the higher-priority substituent on each carbon of the double bond.
fields.explanation: Cl outranks O on the left. Propyl outranks ethyl on the right after the first tied carbon layer; these higher-priority groups are opposite: E.
fields.selectionPrompt: Choose the correct response for b.

fields.label: c
fields.hint: Compare the higher-priority substituent on each carbon of the double bond.
fields.explanation: The upper ring path reaches the methyl-substituted carbon sooner and therefore has higher priority. CO2H outranks CH2OH; the higher-priority groups are on the same side: Z.
fields.selectionPrompt: Choose the correct response for c.

fields.label: d
fields.hint: Compare the higher-priority substituent on each carbon of the double bond.
fields.explanation: CH3 outranks H. The nitrile carbon is compared as attached to N,N,N and outranks CH2NH2 (N,H,H). The higher-priority groups are opposite: E.
fields.selectionPrompt: Choose the correct response for d.
